title: Web Summit, homepage (the 'Important event update' notice)
what_it_says: Web Summit's homepage carries an 'Important event update' notice that Day 2 will not go ahead, linking to the full statement. Read at 22:33 UTC; at 14:34 UTC the article found no such notice. Read again at 12:32 UTC: the notice had been replaced by an announcement that Web Summit is officially back on Thursday 12 November. Read at 20:32 UTC on 11 November: the homepage carries neither the 'Important event update' notice nor the announcement that Web Summit is back on Thursday (both were there earlier); the title is 'Web Summit - The best tech conference on the planet | November 9-12, 2026'.
